configure_imagenet_dataset: configure an ImageNet dataset with 1000 classes and RGB normalization parameters for mmpretrain
configure_train_pipeline: configure a training pipeline with RandomResizedCrop, RandomFlip, AutoAugment, and PackInputs transforms
configure_test_pipeline: configure a test pipeline with ResizeEdge, CenterCrop, and PackInputs transforms for evaluation
configure_train_dataloader: configure a training dataloader with batch size 64 and 5 workers for ImageNet
configure_val_evaluator: configure a validation evaluator using top-1 and top-5 accuracy metrics
